name: WPA Native Knowledge Transformation Model
purpose: Transform legally usable external knowledge signals into source-traceable WPA-native analysis, questions, methodology candidates and communication angles without copying protected expression or presenting external practice as WPA authorship.
core_formula: External Signal -> Rights/Source Gate -> Evidence Atom -> WPA Methodological Reading -> Protocolometry Lens -> Strategy Translation -> WPA-Native Synthesis Candidate -> Human Gate -> Bounded WPA Reuse -> Outcome Measurement -> Correction -> Knowledge Reintegration

institutional_spine.role: keeps mandate, legitimacy, release and final responsibility under Human Authority
truth, doctrine, authorial-dna and anti-drift control; external material cannot rewrite doctrine autonomously
Observe -> Research -> Verify -> Extract Institutional DNA -> Model -> Human Gate -> Apply -> Measure -> Correct -> Publish -> Learn -> Reuse with provenance
turns verified external practice into abstracted, provenance-preserving learning rather than replication
tests observable constructs, evidence completeness, outcome quality, fairness, robustness and correction capacity without automatic ordinal ranking
forces objective, facts/assumptions, leverage, strategy, risks, what-not-to-do, next actions and measurable success criteria
pairs every new capability with dependency, vulnerability, misuse path, pause/override authority and release evidence

wpa_native_contract.external_fact_layer: Keep only source identity, metadata, verified/open signals and bounded evidence objects with provenance.
wpa_native_contract.interpretation_layer: WPA analysis must be a fresh abstraction expressed through WPA concepts, methodological questions and strategic routes, not a paraphrased reproduction of the source.
wpa_native_contract.protocolometry_layer: Every reusable signal asks what is observable, what evidence is required, what outcome could be measured, how gaming or bias could enter, and what correction mechanism is needed.
wpa_native_contract.strategy_layer: Every signal is tested for relevance to WPA doctrine review, research, programmes, curriculum, simulations, Journal, Virtual Sande, Viral Sande, WPAWS, governance, public communication, foresight and institutional development.
wpa_native_contract.human_authority_layer: No candidate becomes doctrine, official judgment, scientific publication, ranking, partnership claim, programme mutation or consequential institutional action without the applicable Human Gate.

originality_and_rights_guardrails: No protected source body is routed into the WPA-native delivery object unless its reuse basis explicitly permits it and the downstream use remains within that basis.
Source titles, author names, institution names, identifiers and short factual metadata remain attributable source facts, not WPA authorship.
Generated WPA-native analysis must not reproduce long source phrases; automated overlap checks flag shared eight-word sequences.

A source idea may inspire a WPA research question or methodology candidate, but the source remains cited and the WPA contribution is labelled as analysis, synthesis, adaptation or new question rather than source fact.
No external institution's programme, curriculum, policy, ranking logic or protected wording is silently adopted as WPA material.
No originality or world-first claim is made merely because the synthesis is WPA-specific; such claims require independent prior-art review.
wpa_voice_principles: Protocol is treated as an institutional ordering mechanism, not decorative ceremony alone.
Evidence precedes confidence; provenance remains visible.
Capability does not create legitimacy or mandate.
Measurement precedes ranking; correction capacity is part of institutional quality.
Institutional practice is compared, not imitated.
External knowledge is tested against WPA doctrine and methodology; it is never allowed to silently redefine them.
Every reusable insight must have a purpose, a boundary, a measurable question and a human owner.
non_claims: Not a plagiarism or source-obscuring system.
Not an autonomous scientific author or peer reviewer.
Not an automatic institution, person or state ranking system.
Not evidence of partnership, affiliation, accreditation or endorsement.
Not an intelligence, surveillance or private-source collection function.
